dimensions.name: Collagen Type & Source
dimensions.description: Is the collagen type (I, II, III) and source (bovine, marine, chicken) specified?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No type/source. 3: 'Collagen' only. 5: Type or source mentioned. 7: Both type and source with explanation. 10: Full type/source breakdown with why specific types matter (I+III for skin, II for joints).

dimensions.name: Molecular Weight & Hydrolysis
dimensions.description: Is hydrolyzed/peptide form explained with molecular weight or Dalton info?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: 'Collagen peptides'. 5: 'Hydrolyzed' stated. 7: Hydrolysis benefit explained. 10: Molecular weight/Dalton data with bioavailability advantage of peptides vs gelatin.

dimensions.name: Dosage & Serving
dimensions.description: Is per-serving collagen grams, scoop size, and servings per container clear?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No dosage. 3: Total weight only. 5: Per-scoop grams. 7: Per-scoop + servings. 10: Full dosage with clinical dose context (10-20g studied doses).

dimensions.name: Dissolving & Taste
dimensions.description: Is dissolving quality, taste/smell profile, and mixing versatility communicated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 5: 'Unflavored' or 'dissolves easily'. 10: Taste-free, odor-free, hot/cold mixing, tested in multiple beverages.

dimensions.name: Benefit Positioning
dimensions.description: Are specific outcomes positioned (skin elasticity, hair growth, nail strength, joint support)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No benefits. 3: Generic 'beauty'. 5: 1-2 benefits. 7: Multi-benefit (skin + hair + nails + joints). 10: Specific outcomes with timeline expectations and audience segmentation.

dimensions.name: Clinical Backing
dimensions.description: Are clinical studies or research references mentioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: 'Scientifically formulated'. 10: Named studies with outcomes (e.g. 'shown to improve skin elasticity in 8 weeks').

dimensions.name: Allergen & Dietary Callouts
dimensions.description: Are grass-fed, pasture-raised, non-GMO, gluten-free, hormone-free stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: Some callouts. 10: Comprehensive sourcing ethics + dietary status.

dimensions.name: Third-Party Testing
dimensions.description: Are third-party testing, heavy metal testing, purity certifications mentioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: Basic claim. 10: Multiple certifications + heavy metal/contaminant testing.

dimensions.name: Keyword Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the listing include category-relevant search terms?

dimensions.name: Trust Signals
dimensions.description: Are GMP, made in USA, satisfaction guarantee, brand story present?
